entries.title: Cross Sentence Escalation
entries.description: A benign sentence becomes harmful only after later dialogue or scene context.
supporting_evidence: Later dialogue provides the harmful meaning.
Objects or actions in a later sentence transform the earlier sentence.
contradictory_evidence: No later sentence adds the harmful meaning.
The later line clearly redirects the scene to a benign meaning.
false_positives: Isolated harmless sentence with no later escalation.
A classroom example used only to explain context.
counter_examples: A benign remark about an envelope.
A scene where the later line is unrelated.
cross_sentence_indicators: Sentence one is neutral; sentence two reveals the security concept.
Objects, actions, or locations are clarified later.
reviewer_guidance: Do not judge the first sentence in isolation.
Track objects and actions across sentences.

confidence_modifiers.title: Later Reveal
confidence_modifiers.description: Later line resolves the earlier ambiguity.

glossary_relationships.note: Weapons references can become harmful across sentences.

gcam_mappings.note: Use when later text turns an earlier neutral line into incitement.
